title: Scoped negative result: certify 33 fixed Clifford register words (no kappa claim)
body:
This adds a standalone, scoped negative result for the complex register search discussed in #288: **33 explicit words with m=3, W=3, s=8 have no full-rank coset endpoint in the formal projective Clifford group algebra, for any three invertible complex scalar mixing matrices at their specified locations. No new primitive or kappa is claimed.** The words do not exhaust the three-block or full register model.

The checker combines necessary Boolean support conditions, invertibility/rank constraints and exact binomial torus equations. Twenty-nine words close by support/rank refutation; four require 78 exact support exclusions before the final Boolean contradiction. The package supplies the literal words, all proof traces, a written model/argument, source provenance and the complete standard-library implementation. It needs no author-local directory, historical checkout or external solver. It also gives four known nine-call solutions and distinguishes a surviving Boolean support from an arithmetic construction.

## Validation

Base: `66849e1475c930fd7732b1a0067ffee7e1e95f60`.

```sh
python -B -S research/clifford-relation-obstructions/verify.py
```

Expected result: `PASS_FIXED_CLIFFORD_WORD_EXCLUSIONS`, with 33 excluded templates and 78 exact torus refutations.

- Direct path enumeration agrees with sequential symbolic propagation; two constructions of the rank clauses agree.
- Literal Boolean proof replay, unimodular integer traces and direct Leibniz determinant identities pass.
- Exact dense checks cover all 33 skeletons, 150 Pauli conjugation identities, seven paid-gate square identities and eight executions of positive controls.
- Negative controls reject damaged traces, Boolean proofs, learned clauses, missing final refutations and an unsupported torsion exclusion. An eight-call word that passes the necessary Boolean filter but fails concretely is retained as a control.
- Fresh standalone-directory replay and alternate gzip compression reproduce identical mathematical output. Corrupt payloads and optimized-Python execution are rejected. Recorded local environment: native Windows, Python 3.14.4.

This addition changes only `research/clifford-relation-obstructions/`. The unchanged repository-wide suite and selected frontier replay were not rerun; no remote CI success is claimed.

## Scope and attribution

The verifier shares the tableau/coset core between its two symbolic encodings; the separate dense matrix controls are finite checks. This is not a Lean proof, an all-size compiler/representation theorem or a bound for arbitrary Clifford words or integer multiplication. No bit-side construction or exponent invoice is supplied.

Credit: eumemic's #288 and its cited predecessors, including Swapnil Jain and the upstream Clifford-frame framework. This supplies additional finite evidence and does not claim priority for the general support, rank or torus methods. Prepared by littleBro with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0. Source pins, overlap context and the full assistance disclosure are in the package notices.
